answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. By the lotus of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, capped per identity per epoch. The island lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the comet is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
